duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive me

duas.title: Dua for Seeking Forgiveness in the Last Part of the Night
duas.arabic: اللهم أنت ربي لا إله إلا أنت
duas.transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa anta
duas.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, there is no god but You

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness and Mercy
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive us and have mercy upon us

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness of Parents
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive my parents

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness After Sin
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive my sin

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness and Protection from Hellfire
duas.translation: O Allah, make us among the people of Paradise

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness in the Morning
duas.translation: O Allah, I have entered the morning bearing witness

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness During the Day
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for forgiveness

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness at the Time of Death
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive me at the time of my death

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness in the Grave
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive him and have mercy on him

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness and Repentance
duas.translation: O Allah, I repent to You

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness Before Fajr Prayer
duas.arabic: اللهم اجعلني من الذين يتوبون إليك
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ajilni min al-ladhina yatubuna ilayk
duas.translation: O Allah, make me among those who repent to You

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness for the Believers
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive the believing men and women

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness for Those Who Are Oppressed
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive the oppressed

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness After a Mistake
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive my mistake

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness in the Last Third of the Night
duas.arabic: اللهم اغفر لي في آخر الليل
duas.transliteration: Allahumma aghfir li fi akhir al-layl
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive me in the last part of the night

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness and Acceptance of Good Deeds
duas.translation: O Allah, accept my good deeds

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness and Relief from Suffering
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alu ka farajan qareeban
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for relief from suffering

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness and Protection from Hellfire
duas.translation: O Allah, make us among the people of Paradise

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness and the Protection of Family
duas.transliteration: Allahumma aghfir li wa li ahli
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive me and my family

duas.title: Dua for Protection from the Evil Eye
duas.arabic: أعوذ بكلمات الله التامات من شر ما خلق
duas.transliteration: A'udhu bikalimatillahi tammati min sharri ma khalaq
duas.translation: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He has created

duas.title: Dua for Protection from Shaitan
duas.translation: I seek refuge with Allah from the accursed devil

duas.title: Dua for Protection from Harmful People
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من شر الناس
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min sharri an-nas
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the evil of the people

duas.title: Dua for Protection from Poverty
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من الفقر
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-faqr
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from poverty

duas.title: Dua for Protection from Harm
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من الضر
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min ad-durr
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from harm

duas.title: Dua for Protection from Enemies
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من عدو
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the enemy

duas.title: Dua for Protection from Sickness
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من المرض
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-marad
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from sickness

duas.title: Dua for Protection from Magic
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من السحر
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min as-sihri
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from magic

duas.title: Dua for Protection from the Fire of Hell
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من عذاب النار
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'adhab an-nar
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the punishment of the Fire

duas.title: Dua for Protection from Anxiety
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من الهم
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-ham
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from anxiety

duas.title: Dua for Protection from Difficulties
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من الشدائد
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min ash-shada'id
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from difficulties

duas.title: Dua for Protection from Unnecessary Fears
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من خوف لا مكان له
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min khawfin la makan lahu
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from fear that has no cause

duas.title: Dua for Protection from Suffering
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من العذاب
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-'adhab
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from suffering

duas.title: Dua for Protection for Family
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من كل مكروه
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min kulli makrooh
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from all harm for my family

duas.title: Dua for Protection from Distress
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من الضيق
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min ad-da'iq
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from distress

duas.title: Dua for Protection from Weakness
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من الضعف
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min ad-da'af
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from weakness

duas.title: Dua for Protection from Bad Dreams
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من الأحلام السيئة
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-ahlam as-sayyi'a
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from bad dreams

duas.title: Dua for Protection from Calamities
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من البلاء
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-bala
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from calamity

duas.title: Dua for Protection from Difficult Trials
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من المحن
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-mihan
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from trials

duas.title: Dua for Protection from Evil Acts
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من سوء العمل
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min su'il 'amal
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from bad actions

duas.title: Dua for Ease in Affairs
duas.translation: O Allah, ease my affair

duas.title: Dua for Ease in Marriage
duas.translation: O Allah, ease my marriage

duas.title: Dua for Ease in Work
duas.translation: O Allah, ease my livelihood

duas.title: Dua for Ease in Health
duas.translation: O Allah, ease my healing

duas.title: Dua for Ease in Difficult Times
duas.translation: O Allah, ease me during difficulties

duas.title: Dua for Ease in Travel
duas.translation: O Allah, ease my travel

duas.title: Dua for Ease in Seeking Knowledge
duas.translation: O Allah, ease my knowledge

duas.title: Dua for Ease in Affairs of the Day
duas.translation: O Allah, ease my day

duas.title: Dua for Ease in Family Matters
duas.translation: O Allah, ease my family matters

duas.title: Dua for Ease in Financial Matters
duas.translation: O Allah, ease my finances

duas.title: Dua for Ease in Prayer
duas.translation: O Allah, ease my prayer

duas.title: Dua for Ease in Work Performance
duas.translation: O Allah, ease my work

duas.title: Dua for Ease in Reaching Goals
duas.transliteration: Allahumma yassir li al-wusul li ahdafi
duas.translation: O Allah, ease my reaching of goals

duas.title: Dua for Ease in Family Growth
duas.translation: O Allah, ease the growth of my children

duas.title: Dua for Ease in All Matters
duas.translation: O Allah, ease all my matters

duas.title: Dua for Ease in Speaking
duas.translation: O Allah, ease my speech

duas.title: Dua for Ease in Communication
duas.translation: O Allah, ease my communication

duas.title: Dua for Ease in Understanding
duas.translation: O Allah, ease my understanding

duas.title: Dua for Ease in Wisdom
duas.translation: O Allah, ease me with wisdom

duas.title: Dua for Ease in Affection
duas.translation: O Allah, ease me with affection

duas.title: Dua for Protection in the Morning
duas.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna wa bika amsina
duas.translation: O Allah, by You we have entered the morning, and by You we enter the evening

duas.title: Dua for Blessings in the Morning
duas.translation: O Allah, make us among the people of the morning

duas.title: Dua for Strength in the Morning
duas.translation: O Allah, make us among the people of strength

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness in the Morning
duas.arabic: اللهم اغفر لي في صباح هذا اليوم
duas.transliteration: Allahumma aghfir li fi sabah hadha al-yawm
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive me in this morning of this day

duas.title: Dua for Guidance in the Morning
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for guidance

duas.title: Dua for Peace in the Morning
duas.translation: O Allah, make our morning peaceful

duas.title: Dua for Sustenance in the Morning
duas.translation: O Allah, provide for me in this morning

duas.title: Dua for Protection from Evil in the Morning
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من شرور هذا اليوم
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min shururi hadha al-yawm
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the evils of this day

duas.title: Dua for Gratitude in the Morning
duas.translation: O Allah, make me among the grateful

duas.title: Dua for Health in the Morning
duas.arabic: اللهم أسألك صحة في هذا اليوم
duas.transliteration: Allahumma as'aluka sihhatin fi hadha al-yawm
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for health in this day

duas.title: Dua for Protection in the Evening
duas.transliteration: Allahumma bika amsina wa bika asbahna
duas.translation: O Allah, by You we enter the evening, and by You we enter the morning

duas.title: Dua for Peace in the Evening
duas.translation: O Allah, make our evening peaceful

duas.title: Dua for Protection from Harm in the Evening
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من كل شر في المساء
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min kulli sharr fi al-masa
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from all harm in the evening

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness in the Evening
duas.arabic: اللهم اغفر لي في مساء هذا اليوم
duas.transliteration: Allahumma aghfir li fi masa' hadha al-yawm
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive me in this evening of this day

duas.title: Dua for Sustenance in the Evening
duas.translation: O Allah, provide for me in this evening

duas.title: Dua for Protection from Evil in the Evening
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من شرور هذا المساء
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min shururi hadha al-masa
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the evils of this evening

duas.title: Dua for Gratitude in the Evening
duas.arabic: اللهم اجعلني من الشاكرين في المساء
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ajilni min ash-shakirin fi al-masa
duas.translation: O Allah, make me among the grateful in the evening

duas.title: Dua for Peaceful Sleep
duas.translation: O Allah, make our sleep peaceful

duas.title: Dua for Strength and Patience
duas.translation: O Allah, make me among the people of patience

duas.title: Dua for Health and Healing
duas.translation: O Allah, cure us from all ailments

duas.title: Dua for Protection at Night
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من شر ما خلقت
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min sharr ma khalaqt
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the evil of what You have created

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness at Night
duas.arabic: اللهم اغفر لي في هذه الليلة
duas.transliteration: Allahumma aghfir li fi hadhih al-layla
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive me in this night

duas.title: Dua for Peaceful Sleep
duas.translation: O Allah, make our sleep good

duas.title: Dua for Healing at Night
duas.translation: O Allah, heal me from every illness

duas.title: Dua for Protection from the Devil at Night
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من الشيطان الرجيم
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min ash-shaytan ar-rajim
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the accursed devil

duas.title: Dua for Guidance at Night
duas.translation: O Allah, make me among the people of guidance

duas.title: Dua for Protection from Nightmares
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من أحلام الليل
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min ahlam al-layl
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the dreams of the night

duas.title: Dua for Safety at Night
duas.translation: O Allah, protect me in this night

duas.title: Dua for Peace of Mind at Night
duas.arabic: اللهم اجعلني من أهل الراحة في الليل
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ajilni min ahl ar-raha fi al-layl
duas.translation: O Allah, make me among the people of peace at night

duas.title: Dua for Light at Night
duas.arabic: اللهم اجعل لي نوراً في هذه الليلة
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ajil li nooran fi hadhih al-layla
duas.translation: O Allah, grant me light in this night

duas.title: Dua for Fajr Prayer
duas.translation: O Allah, make me among the people of Fajr

duas.title: Dua for Dhuhr Prayer
duas.translation: O Allah, make me among the people of Dhuhr

duas.title: Dua for Asr Prayer
duas.translation: O Allah, make me among the people of Asr

duas.title: Dua for Maghrib Prayer
duas.translation: O Allah, make me among the people of Maghrib

duas.title: Dua for Isha Prayer
duas.translation: O Allah, make me among the people of Isha

duas.title: Dua for Before Fajr Prayer
duas.arabic: اللهم اهدني لخير ما في هذا اليوم
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ihdini li khayri ma fi hadha al-yawm
duas.translation: O Allah, guide me to the best of what this day has to offer

duas.title: Dua for Before Dhuhr Prayer
duas.arabic: اللهم اجعلني من الذين يسجدون لك
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ajilni min al-ladhina yasjuduna laka
duas.translation: O Allah, make me among those who prostrate to You

duas.title: Dua for Before Asr Prayer
duas.translation: O Allah, make me among the people of remembrance

duas.title: Dua for Before Maghrib Prayer
duas.translation: O Allah, accept our prayer

duas.title: Dua for Before Isha Prayer
duas.translation: O Allah, make me among the people of prayer

duas.title: Dua for Praising Allah
duas.translation: O Allah, You are the source of peace and from You comes peace

duas.title: Dua for Gratitude to Allah
duas.translation: O Allah, all praise is for You

duas.title: Dua for Seeking Forgiveness from Allah
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive me

duas.title: Dua for Blessings from Allah
duas.translation: O Allah, bless us

duas.title: Dua for Praising Allah after Eating
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من شر الطعام
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min sharri al-ta'am
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the harm of the food

duas.title: Dua for Praising Allah after Drinking
duas.translation: O Allah, bless us in what You have provided us

duas.title: Dua for Praising Allah in Hardship
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من الهم والحزن
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-hammi wal-hazan
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from grief and sorrow

duas.title: Dua for Praising Allah in Difficulty
duas.translation: O Allah, I am Your servant, the son of Your servant

duas.title: Dua for Praising Allah before Sleeping
duas.translation: O Allah, in Your name I die and I live

duas.title: Dua for Praising Allah in the Morning
duas.arabic: الحمد لله الذي أحيانا بعد ما أماتنا وإليه النشور
duas.transliteration: Alhamdulillah alladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur
duas.translation: Praise be to Allah Who has given us life after He has caused us to die, and to Him is the return

duas.title: Dua for Safe Travel
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من وعثاء السفر وكآبة المنقلب
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min 'awtha'i as-safar wa ka'abati al-munqalib
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the hardship of travel and the sorrow of returning

duas.title: Dua for Ease During Travel
duas.arabic: اللهم يسر لنا السفر وسهل لنا الطريق
duas.transliteration: Allahumma yassir lana as-safar wa sahhil lana at-tariq
duas.translation: O Allah, make our travel easy and smooth for us

duas.title: Dua for Protection During Travel
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من شر الطريق
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min sharr at-tariq
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from the evil of the road

duas.title: Dua for Safety During Travel
duas.arabic: اللهم اجعل سفرنا هذا سفرًا مباركًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ajil safaruna hadha safaran mubarakaan
duas.translation: O Allah, make this journey of ours a blessed one

duas.title: Dua for Comfort During Travel
duas.arabic: اللهم اجعلنا في سفرنا هذا من أهل اليسر
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ajilna fi safaruna hadha min ahlil yusr
duas.translation: O Allah, make us from the people of ease during this journey

duas.title: Dua for Safe Return
duas.arabic: اللهم ردنا إلى أهلنا سالمين غانمين
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ruddana ila ahlina salimeen ghanimeen
duas.translation: O Allah, return us to our family safe and victorious

duas.title: Dua for Safe Travel and Return
duas.arabic: اللهم احفظنا في سفرنا هذا من كل سوء
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ihfazna fi safarina hadha min kulli su'a
duas.translation: O Allah, protect us in this journey from every harm

duas.title: Dua for Ease in Long Journeys
duas.arabic: اللهم اجعل سفرنا هذا سفرًا سهلاً ميسرًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ajil safaruna hadha safaran sahlan muyassaran
duas.translation: O Allah, make this journey of ours easy and smooth

duas.title: Dua for Successful Travel
duas.translation: O Allah, make this journey of ours successful

duas.title: Dua for Comfort and Peace During Travel
duas.translation: O Allah, make this journey of ours comfortable and peaceful

duas.title: Dua for Starting Hajj or Umrah
duas.translation: Here I am, O Allah, here I am

duas.title: Dua for Tawaf
duas.arabic: اللهم اجعل طوافنا هذا طوافًا مقبولًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ajil tawafana hadha tawafan maqboolan
duas.translation: O Allah, make this Tawaf of ours an accepted Tawaf

duas.title: Dua for Safa and Marwah
duas.arabic: اللهم اجعل سعيي بين الصفا والمروة مقبولًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ajil sa'yi baina as-safa wal-marwah maqboolan
duas.translation: O Allah, make my Sa'i between Safa and Marwah accepted

duas.title: Dua for Arafat
duas.arabic: اللهم اجعل حجنا هذا حجًا مبرورًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ajil hajjina hadha hajjjan mabrooran
duas.translation: O Allah, make this Hajj of ours a blessed Hajj

duas.title: Dua for Mina
duas.arabic: اللهم اجعل منا هذه الأيام أيامَ خيرٍ وبركة
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ajil mina hadhihi al-ayyam ayaman khayran wa barakah
duas.translation: O Allah, make these days of ours days of goodness and blessings

duas.title: Dua for the Day of Eid
duas.translation: O Allah, accept from us our good deeds

duas.title: Dua for Forgiveness During Hajj
duas.arabic: اللهم اغفر لي ولأهلي ولمن أتى هذا البيت
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ghfir li wa li ahli wa liman ata hadha al-bayt
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive me, my family, and those who come to this house

duas.title: Dua for the Tawaf of the Kaaba
duas.arabic: اللهم اجعل طوافنا هذا طوافًا آمنًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ajil tawafana hadha tawafan amanan
duas.translation: O Allah, make our Tawaf this Tawaf of peace and safety

duas.title: Dua for the Dua at Maqam Ibrahim
duas.arabic: اللهم اجعل مقامنا هذا مقامًا مرفوعًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ajil maqamuna hadha maqaman marfoo'an
duas.translation: O Allah, make our standing at this station one that is elevated

duas.title: Dua for Returning Home After Hajj
duas.translation: O Allah, accept our Hajj and forgive us

duas.title: Dua for Relief from Distress
duas.translation: O Allah, relieve my distress

duas.title: Dua for Joy after Distress
duas.translation: O Allah, replace my sorrow with joy

duas.title: Dua for Patience During Trials
duas.translation: O Allah, make me among the patient ones

duas.title: Dua for Relief from Heavy Heart
duas.translation: O Allah, lighten my burden

duas.title: Dua for Overcoming Distress
duas.translation: O Allah, remove this distress from me

duas.title: Dua for Happiness
duas.translation: O Allah, make me happy in this world and the Hereafter

duas.title: Dua for Happiness of the Heart
duas.translation: O Allah, make my heart happy

duas.title: Dua for Contentment
duas.translation: O Allah, make me content with what You have provided me

duas.title: Dua for Gratitude
duas.translation: O Allah, make me among the grateful ones

duas.title: Dua for Relief from Grief
duas.translation: O Allah, remove my grief

duas.title: Dua for Rain
duas.translation: O Allah, grant us rain that is a mercy

duas.title: Dua for Thunder and Lightning
duas.translation: O Allah, do not destroy us with Your anger

duas.title: Dua for a Good Harvest
duas.translation: O Allah, bless us in our crops

duas.title: Dua for Protection from Harmful Winds
duas.arabic: اللهم إنا نعوذ بك من شر الرياح
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inna na'udhu bika min sharr ar-riyah
duas.translation: O Allah, we seek refuge in You from the harm of the winds

duas.title: Dua for Blessings in Nature
duas.arabic: اللهم اجعل لنا في الطبيعة بركة
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ajil lana fi at-tabi'ah barakah
duas.translation: O Allah, make blessings for us in nature

duas.title: Dua for Safety from Natural Disasters
duas.arabic: اللهم نجنا من الفتن ما ظهر منها وما بطن
duas.transliteration: Allahumma najina min al-fitani ma zahara minha wa ma batana
duas.translation: O Allah, save us from calamities, both apparent and hidden

duas.title: Dua for Protection from Earthquakes
duas.translation: O Allah, make the earth stable for us

duas.title: Dua for the Blessing of the Sun
duas.arabic: اللهم اجعل لنا في الشمس نورًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ajil lana fi ash-shamsi nuran
duas.translation: O Allah, make light for us in the sun

duas.title: Dua for Protection from the Cold
duas.arabic: اللهم إنا نعوذ بك من برد الشديد
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inna na'udhu bika min burd ash-shadid
duas.translation: O Allah, we seek refuge in You from severe cold

duas.title: Dua for Peaceful Environment
duas.translation: O Allah, make this place blessed

duas.title: Dua for Healing
duas.arabic: اللهم اشفني شفاءً لا يغادر سقماً
duas.transliteration: Allahumma shfini shifa'an la yughadiru saqaman
duas.translation: O Allah, heal me with a healing that leaves no sickness behind

duas.title: Dua for Relief from Pain
duas.arabic: اللهم أذهب البأس، رب الناس، اشفِ أنت الشافي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma adhhib al-ba’sa, rabb an-nas, ishfi anta ash-shafi
duas.translation: O Allah, remove the pain, O Lord of the people, cure, for You are the Healer

duas.title: Dua for Fever
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من البرص والجنون والجذام وسيئ الأسقام
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-baras wal-junun wal-judhami wa sayyi'il asqam
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from leprosy, madness, skin disease, and evil sicknesses

duas.title: Dua for Recovery
duas.arabic: اللهم عافني في بدني، اللهم عافني في سمعي، اللهم عافني في بصري
duas.transliteration: Allahumma 'afini fi badani, Allahumma 'afini fi sam'i, Allahumma 'afini fi basari
duas.translation: O Allah, grant me health in my body, grant me health in my hearing, grant me health in my sight

duas.title: Dua for Protection from Harmful Diseases
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من الجذام والبرص والمجنون
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-judhami wal-barasi wal-majnuni
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from leprosy, scabies, and madness

duas.title: Dua for Health and Well-being
duas.arabic: اللهم اجعلني من أهل الصحة والعافية
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ajilni min ahl as-sihha wal-‘afiya
duas.translation: O Allah, make me one of the people of health and well-being

duas.title: Dua for Cure from Pain
duas.arabic: اللهم اشفني شفاءً لا يغادر سقماً
duas.transliteration: Allahumma shfini shifa'an la yughadiru saqaman
duas.translation: O Allah, heal me with a healing that leaves no sickness behind

duas.title: Dua for Relief from Fever
duas.arabic: اللهم أذهب البأس، رب الناس، اشفِ أنت الشافي
duas.transliteration: Allahumma adhhib al-ba’sa, rabb an-nas, ishfi anta ash-shafi
duas.translation: O Allah, remove the pain, O Lord of the people, cure, for You are the Healer

duas.title: Dua for Protection from Diseases
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من العمى والفالج والجنون
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min al-‘ama wal-falaji wal-jununi
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from blindness, paralysis, and madness

duas.title: Dua for Relief from Illness
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أسالك العافية في الدنيا والآخرة
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alu-ka al-‘afiya fi ad-dunya wal-akhira
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for health in this world and the Hereafter

duas.title: Dua Before Eating
duas.translation: In the name of Allah and upon the blessings of Allah

duas.title: Dua After Eating
duas.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَطْعَمَنَا وَسَقَانَا وَجَعَلَنَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi alladhi at'amana wa saqana wa ja'alana mina al-muslimeen
duas.translation: Praise be to Allah who fed us and gave us drink and made us Muslims

duas.title: Dua for Barakah in Food
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَسَقِنَا خَيْرًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma barik lana fihi wa saqina khayran
duas.translation: O Allah, bless us in it and give us the best of it

duas.title: Dua Before Drinking Water
duas.translation: O Allah, make it a source of blessing

duas.title: Dua for Sweetness in Food
duas.translation: O Allah, make mercy dear to me

duas.title: Dua for Thirst
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْقِنَا غَيْرَ ضَارٍّ وَلَا مُضِرٍّ
duas.transliteration: Allahumma asqina ghayra darin wa la mudirrin
duas.translation: O Allah, give us to drink without harm or injury

duas.title: Dua for Satisfying Hunger
duas.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ لِي فِي الطَّعَامِ بَرَكَةً
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ajil li fi at-ta'ami barakah
duas.translation: O Allah, make blessings for me in food

duas.title: Dua for Cleanliness After Eating
duas.translation: O Allah, purify us with the blessings

duas.title: Dua for Gratitude After Eating
duas.translation: O Allah, all praise is for You

duas.title: Dua for Refreshing Drink
duas.translation: O Allah, remove hunger and thirst from us

duas.title: Dua for Good Manners
duas.translation: O Allah, beautify me with good manners

duas.title: Dua for Respect for Parents
duas.translation: My Lord, have mercy on them as they brought me up when I was small

duas.title: Dua for Humility
duas.translation: O Allah, make me among the humble

duas.title: Dua for Politeness
duas.translation: O Allah, make me among the kind

duas.title: Dua for Gratitude in Speech
duas.translation: O Allah, improve my speech

duas.title: Dua for Kindness
duas.translation: O Allah, make me among those who are patient

duas.title: Dua for Self-Control
duas.translation: O Allah, accept me among the patient

duas.title: Dua for Respect for Others
duas.translation: O Allah, make me among those who respect people

duas.title: Dua for Generosity
duas.translation: O Allah, make me among the generous

duas.title: Dua for Purity in Intentions
duas.translation: O Allah, make my intentions purely for You

duas.title: Dua for Patience in Difficulty
duas.arabic: رَبِّ إِنِّي مَسَّنِيَ الضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرْحَمُ الرَّاحِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabb inni massaniyad-du'ru wa anta arhamur rahimeen
duas.translation: My Lord, indeed adversity has touched me, and You are the most merciful of the merciful.

duas.title: Dua for Patience in Trials
duas.translation: Indeed, with hardship comes ease.

duas.title: Dua for Patience in the Face of Hardship
duas.arabic: اللهم اجعل لي من كل هم فرجًا ومن كل ضيق مخرجًا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ajil li min kulli hammin farajan wa min kulli dayqin makhrajaa
duas.translation: O Allah, make for me from every distress a way out and from every hardship relief.

duas.title: Dua for Patience in Adversity
duas.arabic: وَإِذَا صَابَتْهُمْ مُصِيبَةٌ قَالُوا إِنَّا لِلّهِ وَإِنَّـا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعونَ
duas.transliteration: Wa idha saabat-hum museebatun qalu inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raaji'oon
duas.translation: And when a disaster strikes them, they say, 'Indeed, we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him is our return.'

duas.title: Dua for Patience in Loss
duas.arabic: اللهم أجرني في مصيبتي واخلف لي خيرًا منها
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ajirni fee museebati wakhlef li khayran minha
duas.translation: O Allah, reward me for my affliction and replace it for me with something better.

duas.title: Dua for Endurance During Hardships
duas.arabic: رَبِّ لَا تَذَرْنِي فَرْدًا وَأَنتَ خَيْرُ الْوَارِثِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabb la tadharni fardan wa anta khayrul waritheen
duas.translation: My Lord, do not leave me alone [without an heir], and You are the best of inheritors.

duas.title: Dua for Patience in Sickness
duas.arabic: اللهم اشفني شفاءً لا يغادر سقما
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ishfini shifaa'an la yughadiru saqaman
duas.translation: O Allah, heal me with a healing that leaves no illness behind.

duas.title: Dua for Patience in Difficult Moments
duas.translation: And above every knowledgeable person is one more knowledgeable.

duas.title: Dua for Patience and Strength
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أسالك الصبر عند البلاء والرضا بالقضاء
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alu ka as-sabr 'inda al-bala' wal-ridaa bil-qada'
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for patience during trials and contentment with Your decree.

duas.title: Dua for Patience in Waiting
duas.transliteration: Wa sabirhum inna ka anta al-wahid
duas.translation: And give them patience, for indeed You are the One, the Eternal.

duas.title: Dua for Guidance and Righteousness
duas.translation: Guide us to the straight path.

duas.title: Dua for Guidance to Goodness
duas.translation: O Allah, guide me and make me steadfast.

duas.title: Dua for Guidance in Decision Making
duas.arabic: اللهم إني استخيرك بعلمك واستقدرك بقدرتك
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni asta'khiruka bi'ilmik wa astaqdairuka biqudratik
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek Your guidance through Your knowledge and seek Your ability through Your power.

duas.title: Dua for Guidance to the Right Path
duas.translation: O Allah, make me among the people of Jannah.

duas.title: Dua for Guidance to Truth
duas.arabic: اللهم أرنا الحق حقًا وارزقنا اتباعه
duas.transliteration: Allahumma arina al-haqqa haqqa wa rizuqna ittiba'ahu
duas.translation: O Allah, show us the truth as truth and grant us the ability to follow it.

duas.title: Dua for Guidance in Religion
duas.translation: O Allah, keep me firm on Your religion.

duas.title: Dua for Guidance in Knowledge
duas.arabic: اللهم علمنا ما ينفعنا وانفعنا بما علمتنا
duas.transliteration: Allahumma 'allimna ma yanfa'una wa anfa'na bima 'allamtana
duas.translation: O Allah, teach us what benefits us and benefit us with what You have taught us.

duas.title: Dua for Guidance to Good Actions
duas.arabic: اللهم اجعلني من الذين يسمعون القول فيتبعون أحسنه
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ajilni min al-ladhina yasma'oon al-qawla fayattabi'oon ahsanah
duas.translation: O Allah, make me among those who listen to the word and follow the best of it.

duas.title: Dua for Guidance and Forgiveness
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ghfir li wa hdini li
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive me and guide me.

duas.title: Dua for Guidance and Blessing
duas.arabic: اللهم اهدنا إلى أحسن الأخلاق لا يهدي لأحسنها إلا أنت
duas.transliteration: Allahumma hdina ila ahsani al-akhlaqi la yahdi li ahsaniha illa anta
duas.translation: O Allah, guide us to the best of manners, for none can guide to the best of them except You.

duas.title: Dua for Strength in Difficult Times
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أسالك القوة في الشدائد
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alu ka al-quwwah fi ash-shada'id
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for strength in difficult times

duas.title: Dua for Inner Strength
duas.translation: O Allah, strengthen my faith

duas.title: Dua for Strength in Facing Challenges
duas.translation: O Allah, make me among the patient

duas.title: Dua for Strength in Adversity
duas.translation: O Allah, make me among the people of strength

duas.title: Dua for Mental Strength
duas.translation: O Allah, strengthen my mind

duas.title: Dua for Strength Against Weakness
duas.arabic: اللهم إني أعوذ بك من الضعف
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni a'udhu bika min ad-da'af
duas.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge with You from weakness

duas.title: Dua for Strength to Overcome Fear
duas.arabic: اللهم اجعلني من الذين لا يخافون
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ajilni min al-ladhina la yakhafun
duas.translation: O Allah, make me among those who fear not

duas.title: Dua for Physical Strength
duas.translation: O Allah, grant me physical strength

duas.title: Dua for Strength in Faith and Practice
duas.translation: O Allah, make me firm in my faith

duas.title: Dua for Strength to Endure Trials
duas.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'alu ka quwwat as-sabr
duas.translation: O Allah, I ask You for the strength of patience

duas.title: Dua for Parents’ Well-Being
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ihfaz walidayya wa barik fihima
duas.translation: O Allah, protect my parents and bless them

duas.title: Dua for Parents’ Forgiveness
duas.transliteration: Allahumma aghfir li walidayya wagh-sil khatayahuma
duas.translation: O Allah, forgive my parents and wash away their sins

duas.title: Dua for Parents’ Peace
duas.arabic: اللهم اجعل حياة والدَيّ مليئة بالسلام
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ajil hayata walidayya mal'iya bil-salam
duas.translation: O Allah, make the lives of my parents filled with peace

duas.title: Dua for Parents’ Health
duas.arabic: اللهم اشفِ والديّ من كل مرض
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ishfi walidayya min kulli marad
duas.translation: O Allah, cure my parents from every illness

duas.title: Dua for Parents’ Happiness
duas.arabic: اللهم أسعد والدَيّ في الدنيا والآخرة
duas.transliteration: Allahumma as'id walidayya fi al-dunya wal-akhirah
duas.translation: O Allah, make my parents happy in this world and the Hereafter

duas.title: Dua for Parents’ Success
duas.arabic: اللهم اجعل والديّ من أهل الجنة
duas.translation: O Allah, make my parents among the people of Jannah

duas.title: Dua for Parents’ Long Life
duas.arabic: اللهم أطِل عمر والديّ في طاعتك
duas.translation: O Allah, prolong the life of my parents in Your obedience

duas.title: Dua for Parents’ Ease
duas.translation: O Allah, make the affairs of my parents easy

duas.title: Dua for Parents’ Protection
duas.arabic: اللهم احفظ والدَيّ من كل سوء
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ihfaz walidayya min kulli su'
duas.translation: O Allah, protect my parents from all harm

duas.title: Dua for Parents’ Guidance
duas.arabic: اللهم اجعل والدَيّ من أهل الهدى
duas.translation: O Allah, make my parents among the people of guidance

duas.title: Dua for a Good Spouse
duas.translation: O Allah, grant me a righteous spouse

duas.title: Dua for a Compatible Partner
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ajil baynana mawaddatan wa rahmatan
duas.translation: O Allah, make between us love and mercy

duas.title: Dua for a Blessed Marriage
duas.translation: O Allah, bless our marriage

duas.title: Dua for Ease in Marriage
duas.translation: O Allah, ease the affair of my marriage

duas.title: Dua for Protection from Divorce
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ajil baynana ulfatan wa rahmatan
duas.translation: O Allah, place affection and mercy between us

duas.title: Dua for Mutual Understanding
duas.translation: O Allah, teach us how to understand each other

duas.title: Dua for Happiness in Marriage
duas.translation: O Allah, make my marriage blessed

duas.title: Dua for Guidance in Marriage
duas.translation: O Allah, make us among the people of Paradise

duas.title: Dua for Love and Affection
duas.translation: O Allah, make me beloved to my spouse

duas.title: Dua for Peace in Marriage
duas.transliteration: Allahumma ajil baynana sakinah wa tumaneenah
duas.translation: O Allah, place tranquility and peace between us
